items.t: Intellia Therapeutics (NTLA), Why Is It Back In The Spotlight?
items.sum: MAGNITUDE-2 trial milestone puts Intellia Therapeutics in focus The trigger for fresh attention on Intellia Therapeutics (NTLA) is clear. The business has finished enrolling patients in MAGNITUDE-2, its Phase 3 trial of nex-z for hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis with polyneuropathy.
